mapper.select: select sys_id, user_id, plant_cd, user_role from sys_user where sys_id = #{sysId} and delete_yn = 'N' order by sys_id for update
mapper.update: update sys_user set user_role = '01', modify_user_id = #{userId}, modify_datetime = now() where sys_id = #{sysId} and plant_cd = #{plantCd} and plant_cd != 'ADMIN' and user_role = '02' and delete_yn = 'N'
